title: Skillet Tunisian Baked Bysta
description: A flavorful and spicy Tunisian dish made with baked bysta topped with a herbaceous bryndza cheese blend, perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together parsley, cilantro, oregano, garlic powder, and paprika.
In a separate bowl, crumble the bryndza cheese.
In the skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the bysta to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the bysta is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top the bysta with the bryndza cheese mixture.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Skillet Tunisian Baked Bysta hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.
